prompts.title: Regenerate all documentation
prompts.body: Run `python scripts/update_all.py`, then show me the git diff for docs/ and explain in one sentence per file what changed and why.

prompts.title: Add a new generator
prompts.body: Create scripts/generate_<name>.py following the existing generators: a `generate(generated_at)` function returning {filename: markdown}, an AUTO-GENERATED header, idempotent output. Register it in scripts/update_all.py and add a test in tests/.

prompts.title: Investigate a drift-check failure
prompts.body: `python scripts/update_all.py --check` failed in CI. Diff the committed docs/ against freshly generated output, identify which source change was not reflected, and tell me whether the fix is to regenerate or to revert.

prompts.title: Refresh the benchmark numbers
prompts.body: Run `python benchmarks/bench_generation.py`, commit the updated benchmarks/results.json and docs/API.md, and summarise how our generation time compares to pdoc and sphinx-apidoc.
